title: The History of Sovereign Citizens (Abridged)
summary: Short history from the Constitution through the tax-protest movement, Posse Comitatus, Montana Freemen and police killings, concluding the theories never worked.

assertions.quote: in the early 1980s the posse comet as changed into the sovereign citizen movement
there are plenty of other reports of officers being killed in the line of duty by sovereign citizens
it's clear why the FBI classifies the sovereign citizen movement as domestic terrorism

verdicts.note: The FBI's 2010-2011 publications call sovereign-citizen extremists a domestic terrorist threat, though that targets violent extremists, not all believers.

assertions.quote: if you're a sovereign citizen it didn't work then and it won't work now
